title: manual busywork → automate automation, using Zapier
caption:
manual busywork → automate automation, using Zapier

Most people get this wrong. Avoid these:
1️⃣ Pick one trigger — New form, new email, new sale — one real event starts the chain. Two triggers = double the chaos.
2️⃣ Append the next step — Sheet row, Slack ping, CRM entry — whatever you'd otherwise do by hand at 11 PM.
3️⃣ Run one real event — Watch it fire end-to-end before you trust it with a customer. Test rows expose broken filters.
4️⃣ Chain the hand-offs — Lead → sheet → welcome email → CRM. Five simple Zaps replace a VA's entire morning.
